3545.name: Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power Fish Hunter Arcade Machine
3545.content:
![](/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/ok3dp-splash2-1008x1024.png)

Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power is the latest IGS game in the Ocean King fish hunting series. It is loaded with all-new characters and game features that both first-time and experienced Fish hunters will enjoy.

In Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power, six, eight or ten players can battle it out to catch as many of the 28 fish characters as possible within the game's timeframe.

Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power features include high quality 3D graphics, under the sea themes, more fish characters and **improved difficulty that reaches level 26**.



## How to Play

The aim of Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power is for players to use their guns and its three settings - normal, accelerated and aim for the target - to catch as many fish as possible within the time frame of the game.

In Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power there are 28 fish to catch, all of which are worth different point values. Players increase their point scores by the number and value of fish they capture during games.

The main gameplay in Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power is layered with features and mini-games. These are important to use as they give players a higher chance to earn more points and in turn, the potential to earn more winnings.



## Features

The features in Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power include:

### Lightning Chain

Fish species will appear as Lightning Fish. Lighting Fish can be: flying fish, clown fish, butterfly fish, fugu, lionfish, flatfish, lobster, spearfish and octopus. Catching a Lightning Fish will trigger a Lightning Chain. Lightning Chain will continue to catch fish automatically until time runs out.


### Vortex Fish

Fish species will appear as Vortex Fish.
Vortex Fish can be: flying fish, clown fish, butterfly fish, fugu, lionfish, flatfish, lobster, spearfish, octopus, lantern fish, sea turtle and saw shark. Catching a Vortex Fish will suck all fish of the same species in the area into a whirlpool.

![Lightning Fish](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Lightning-Fish-a-768x432.jpg)

![Lightning Fish](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Vortex-Fish-a-768x432.jpg)


### Fast Bombs

It's a free single player game available for a limited time, randomly accessible through the main game. Players are able to catch fish within the limited time. Press SHOOT button for continuous attack.

![Fast Bombs](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Fast-Bombs-2a-768x432.jpg)

![Fast Bombs](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Fast-Bombs-a-768x432.jpg)


### Fire Storm

It's a free single player game for a limited time, randomly accessible through the main game. Players are able to catch fish within the limited time and may obtain additional time and multiply their scores during the game. When pressing the SHOOT button in quick succession, you can increase the attack speed. The final scores will be multiplied by the multiplying value as the result.

![Fire Storm](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Fire-Storm-a-768x432.jpg)

![Fire Storm](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Fire-Storm-2-a-768x432.jpg)


### Golden Treasures

It's a free multi player game for a limited time, randomly accessible through the main game. Players use the searchlight and look for Imperial Whale and Golden Fish to get high scores. Players may obtain a roulette treasure box that adds in or multiplies the total scores.

![Golden Treasures](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Golden-Treasures-2a-768x432.jpg)

![Golden Treasures](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Golden-Treasures-a-768x432.jpg)



## Power Ups

### Almighty Octopus Power Up

Catching the Almighty Octopus - Power Up summons the tentacles of the Almighty Octopus to attack all the fish in the sea. This gives you a chance to multiply your win.

![Almighty Octopus Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/almighty-octopus-1a-768x431.jpg)

![Almighty Octopus Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/almighty-octopus-2a-768x431.jpg)


### Ancient Crocodile Power Up

Catching the Ancient Crocodile - Power Up summons waves of giant crocodiles to attack all the fish in the sea. This gives you a chance to multiply your win.

![Ancient Crocodile Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/ancient-crocodile-1a-768x431.jpg)

![Ancient Crocodile Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/ancient-crocodile-2a-768x431.jpg)


### Darkness Monster Power Up

Catching the Darkness Monster - Power Up can summon seven waves of giant Lantern Fish to attack all the fish in the sea. This gives you a chance to multiply your win

![Darkness Monster Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/darkness-monster-1a-768x431.jpg)

![Darkness Monster Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/darkness-monster-2a-768x431.jpg)


### Emperor Crab Power Up

Catching the Emperor Crab - Power Up summons waves of multiple crabs to attack all the fish in the sea with a lightning attack. This gives you a chance to multiply your win.

![Emperor Crab Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/emperor-crab-1a-768x431.jpg)

![Emperor Crab Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/emperor-crab-2a-768x431.jpg)


### Fire Dragon Turtle Power Up

Catching the Fire Dragon Turtle - Power Up causes the Fire Dragon Turtle to explode attacking all the fish in the sea. This gives you a chance to multiply your win.

![Fire Dragon Turtle Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/fire-dragon-turtle-1a-768x431.jpg)

![Fire Dragon Turtle Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/fire-dragon-turtle-2a-768x431.jpg)


### Flaming Dragon Power Up

Catching the Flaming Dragon - Power Up can summon seven waves of 4 dragons to attack all the fish in the sea. This gives you a chance to multiply your win.

![Flaming Dragon Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/flameing-dragon-1a-768x431.jpg)

![Flaming Dragon Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/flameing-dragon-2a-768x431.jpg)

![Thunder Dragon Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/thunder-dragon-1-768x431.jpg)

![Thunder Dragon Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/thunder-dragon-2-768x431.jpg)



## Mini Games

The mini-games in Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power include:


### Super Bomb Crab

Catching a Bomb Crab will trigger the chained bomb attack in a wide explosion. It may give players a chance to help catch fish within.

![Super Bomb Crab](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Super-Bomb-Crab-2a-300x169.jpg)

![Super Bomb Crab](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Super-Bomb-Crab-1-300x169.jpg)


### Laser Crab

You will get one shot using a laser beam for a limited time.

![Laser Crab](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Laser-Crab-2a-300x169.jpg)

![Laser Crab](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Laser-Crab-1-1-300x169.jpg)


### Drill Crab

When a Drill Crab is caught it fires drills, penetrating the area and may have a chance to catch the fish. The drill explodes after a while, and may also give you a chance to catch the fish within the explosion range.

![Drill Crab](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Drill-Crab-2a-300x169.jpg)

![Drill Crab](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Drill-Crab-1-1-300x169.jpg)


### Roulette Crab

Golden Roulette is a bonus game. You press the SHOOT button to stop the roulette. The bigger the roulette number, the higher the score.

![Roulette Crab](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Roulette-Crab-2a-300x169.jpg)

![Roulette Crab](/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Roulette-Crab-1-300x169.jpg)



## Fish Characters

Flying Fish, Clown Fish, Butterfly Fish, Fugu, Lionfish, Flatfish, Lobster, Spearfish, Octopus, Lantern Fish, Sea Turtle, Saw Shark, Devilfish, Jumbo Fish, Super Bomb Crab, Laser Crab, Drill Crab, Roulette Crab, Shark, Killer Whale, Imperial Whale, Blazing Dragon.
Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power now features Power ups to six classic fish bosses including : Fire Dragon Turtle Power Up, Almighty Octopus Power Up, Emperor Crab Power Up, Darkness Monster Power Up, Ancient Crocodile Power Up, Flaming Dragon Power Up and Thunder Dragon - Power Up.


![Almighty Octopus Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ocean-King-3-Almighty-Octopus-Power-Up-300x228.png)

![Ancient Crocodile Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ocean-King-3-Ancient-Crocodile-Power-Up-300x228.png)

![Emperor Crab Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ocean-King-3-Emperor-Crab-Power-Up-300x228.png)

![Fire Dragon Turtle Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ocean-King-3-Fire-Dragon-Turtle-Power-Up-300x228.png)

![Darkness Monster Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ocean-King-3-Darkness-Monster-Power-Up-300x228.png)

![Flaming Dragon Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ocean-King-3-Flaming-Dragon-Power-Up-300x228.png)

![Thunder Dragon Power Up](/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ocean-King-3-thunder-dragon-Power-Up-300x228.jpg)



## Shipping

The Ocean King 3 : Dragon Power game is available to buy on its own or can be shipped pre-loaded on Arcooda's six, eight or soon to be released 10-player fish machine.

Arcooda 10 Player Fish Cabinet dimensions: 163 W x 205 D x 98H (cms), 250 kgs

Arcooda 8 Player Fish Cabinet dimensions: 163 W x 205 D x 98H (cms), 250 kgs

Arcooda 6 Player Fish Cabinet dimensions: 145 W x 194 D x 93 H (cms), 250 kgs

Sea freight (estimated arrival 35-45 days) and air cargo (7-14 days) is available for Arcooda's fish machines.



## Configurations

Arcooda fish cabinets are available as:

- Key In/Key Out version machine
- Coin In/Coin Out
- Bill Acceptor/Thermal Printer
- Coin In/Ticket Redemption Out (for FEC and arcade centres)
- PlayPortal Cashless System




**LEGAL NOTICE**: Our sister company Highway Games was the first to distribute the IGS fish hunting series into the USA, Australia, and Europe. We are aware of unauthorised copied reproductions of these games being marketed as original IGS product or variations, especially from China market sellers. If you are unsure whether or not what you are buying is a copy product, please contact our sales team for assistance.
